summary: Iteration 11 frontend bug-hunt (Codex + Story + Veteran + Direct-nav L7/L10 + Regression). PASS: (1) Home renders all 4 action cards (ROBOTS, MAP, COMMANDER, CODEX). (2) Codex modal opens showing all 10 levels; L1 unlocked, L2-L10 locked with lock icon. (3) Codex X-button closes modal (backdrop tap not fully tested — see notes). (4) Codex L1 tap routes to /story?level=1&force=1&flavor=1 correctly. (5) Fleet difficulty toggle: STANDARD MODE (shield) ↔ VETERAN MODE (skull) works; description strings correct ('2× wave density  +30% alien HP/ATK  2× parts reward'). (6) AsyncStorage persistence: re-navigating to /fleet after toggle keeps VETERAN active. (7) Level pins turn red-bordered in Veteran mode (visible in screenshot). (8) L1 tap in Veteran → /story?level=1&difficulty=veteran (difficulty param preserved). (9) Story SKIP forwards to /battle?level=1&difficulty=veteran. (10) Battle shows 'VETERAN · 2× REWARDS' badge next to ALIEN CORE (verified via text match). (11) Toggle back to standard restores STANDARD MODE label. (12) Direct-nav /battle?level=7&difficulty=veteran and /battle?level=10&difficulty=veteran load with no JS errors and VETERAN badge visible. (13) Robots preview modal opens for SCOUT with stats (COST 2⚡, HP 220, ATK 16, SPEED 1.3x, RATE 1.1s) + CLOSE button. (14) /epilogue reachable via direct-nav. FAIL/ISSUES: (A) /api/v2/story/{id}?flavor=1 takes ~12s (Gemini) — during that time the story screen shows only a small spinner on a black screen with NO skeleton/hint/'AI GENERATING' indicator. Poor UX and blocks user perception of progress. (B) Retest run showed story screen stuck on loading spinner when navigating story?level=1 (no force) — suspected race between useEffect re-runs when useLocalSearchParams populates asynchronously; however primary flows (fleet→level-1) work reliably so this is a low-severity edge case (may be Playwright-context specific). (C) Combo x3 banner verification skipped — known from iter 8 to be blocked by deploy-landing race (not re-tested; main agent should fix per iter 8 RCA). Deprecation warnings persist: shadow*/textShadow*/props.pointerEvents. Console 404s on 3 asset loads (non-blocking). No red-screen, no JS crash across all tested screens.

minor.issue: Gemini call takes ~12s (measured: 11.93s). Frontend shows only a small spinner on black background during this time. Consider streaming/optimistic-render: show cached panels first, then swap in flavor_line when it arrives. Currently panels are gated behind flavor completion because a single fetch bundles them.

ui_bugs.issue: When flavor=1 is present, the entire story screen (panels, title, top bar) is hidden behind a small spinner for ~12s while Gemini responds. Users cannot tell if the app has hung. Panels are static data available from /api/v2/config so they should render immediately with the flavor banner appearing (or a 'GENERATING…' shimmer) when it arrives.

issues: No skeleton or 'GENERATING BRIEFING…' text during the 12s Gemini call — bad first-time impression for new players.
RN-Web deprecation warnings persist: shadow*, textShadow*, props.pointerEvents (also present in Iter 8 report).

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated in RN-Web. Migrate to `boxShadow` / `textShadow` string form. Reference: multiple screens (battle.tsx, command.tsx, story.tsx).
`pointerEvents` as a prop is deprecated. Move to `style.pointerEvents`. Reference: story.tsx:122 (<View style={styles.scanlines} pointerEvents='none' />), plus battle.tsx overlays.

action_items: story.tsx: split fetch into two phases — render static panels immediately from api.v2Story(level, false), then optionally trigger a lightweight /api/v2/story/{level}/flavor endpoint OR fire-and-await Gemini in the background and set flavor_line via setState when it arrives. This eliminates the 12s black-screen UX.
Alternatively add a 'GENERATING BRIEFING…' loading text + subtle animation to the current spinner so the 12s wait is explained to users.

Fix the deploy-landing race in battle.tsx (unresolved from iter 8 — use useRef mirror or restructure the RAF loop useEffect deps) so COMBO x3 banner can be reliably verified and gameplay feels responsive.
Migrate shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents to their non-deprecated APIs (RN 0.76+).

Consider making backdrop tap-to-dismiss on the Codex modal explicit (currently backdrop is a plain View, not a Pressable — user must use the X button). Reference: command.tsx:94 (codexBackdrop is <View>, not <Pressable>).
Investigate 3 recurring HTTP 404 asset requests in console (source not identified — may be missing font weight or asset variant).
critical_code_review_comments: command.tsx:93-95: <View style={styles.codexBackdrop}> is not tappable — the Codex modal cannot be dismissed by tapping the backdrop, only via the X button. Wrap the backdrop in a Pressable with onPress={() => setCodexOpen(false)} and add an inner Pressable/View with onPress stopPropagation to prevent card-tap dismissal.
story.tsx:56-60: api.v2Story(levelId, flavorReq) blocks the entire panel render on Gemini's slow response. Panels are deterministic and could render before flavor_line arrives.
engine.ts / battle.tsx: unresolved deploy-landing race from iter 8 still hampers UX testability of combo mechanic.
fleet.tsx:36 useFocusEffect(useCallback(() => { load(); }, [load])) — load() is stable via useCallback([]) so this is fine; noted only for future-proofing.

story.tsx:32: difficulty derivation is one-way (params → local) — no way to persist difficulty across a full-page reload other than the URL query string. Should also consider reading DIFF_KEY from AsyncStorage as a fallback for RETRY paths.

success_rate.frontend: Codex modal 90% (10-level list + X-close OK; backdrop-close not implemented). Story flow 70% (routing + skip + difficulty-preservation OK; 12s black-screen on flavor=1 is UX bug). Veteran toggle 100% (toggle + persistence + red pins + URL-preservation + battle badge all OK). Direct-nav L7/L10 100% (no crashes + badge visible). Robots preview 100%. Epilogue 100%. Combo x3 banner: NOT TESTED (blocked by known iter 8 deploy-race).

seed_data_creation: Codenames VETHUNTER and VETRETEST auto-init via home flow (fresh player docs in Mongo).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Primary flow (Fleet → toggle Veteran → L1 pin → Story → SKIP → Battle with VETERAN badge) is fully working. Backend v2Story with flavor=1 takes ~12s (Gemini) — allow >=15s wait in Playwright before asserting on story-next / panel text. Codex→L1→story?flavor=1 same issue. Combo verification remains blocked by the useEffect/RAF race in battle.tsx documented in iter 8 (use ref-based state mirror). Veteran wave count at t=14s was not visually counted from screenshots (crawlers are small green squares in a dark field, hard to differentiate at low quality), but engine.ts:130-138 confirms the veteran expansion adds a duplicate 1.5s later per wave — code-level path verified.
rca_of_issue: 12s black-screen on story flavor=1: api.v2Story fetches BOTH panels and Gemini flavor in a single blocking Promise. story.tsx setLoading(false) only after both resolve. Fix: split into two awaits (panels first — instant; flavor second — background) or add a UI hint. Codex backdrop non-dismiss: backdrop is a plain <View> not Pressable — trivial fix.
